title: Desktop app
lead: Press TAB and it reads the scoreboard and fills the board for you. No switching windows mid-game.
f1: Both teams' heroes, your slot, banned heroes and the match rank range, applied to the board and the stats filters.
f2: The top 3 picks in a small overlay. It can show only while you hold TAB.
f3: Flags an enemy whose scoreboard numbers stand far above others in the same role.
f4: It grabs the game window only while TAB is held. The rest of the time it idles.
safety: No access to the game process, memory, network packets or game files. Of the keyboard it only watches TAB and drops every other key. Captures stay on your computer.
osOrder: Files for your system ({{os}}) are shown first
exeHint: Run the downloaded file to install.
flatpakHint: Add the repository once, then install and update with Flatpak.
flatpakUpdate: Update with flatpak update com.seolcu.pickgak or GNOME Software.
flatpakTray: The Flatpak has no tray icon. Use the overlay button in the main window; closing it quits.
requirements: Linux (X11 or XWayland) or Windows 10 1903 and newer. Tested with Overwatch running through Steam (Proton). Windows needs WebView2, which Windows 11 includes.
step2: Run Overwatch in borderless windowed mode
step3: Hold TAB in game and the board fills in
mobileNote: This is a PC app. On your phone, keep using this website.
bannerTitle: The desktop app fills the board when you press TAB
